description: The run_agent receipt: the base shape is VERBATIM from the golden instances (evidence/demo-run.json + a fresh offline run, both in ../golden/) — same keys, same nullability (an ABSTAIN run carries null plan/quiz/replan/evidence_set/trust_receipt; a planning run carries them populated). The live-run extension members (execution_class · model · tool_trace · fail_closed) are OPTIONAL here and REQUIRED by policy on any receipt whose execution is live: the offline goldens predate the extension and must keep validating, while a production receipt without execution_class fails its review, not this schema. Production receipts are DISTINCT (execution_class=live-production), never confusable with the deterministic offline-gate receipts.

decision_final.description: Golden-observed vocabulary (demo-run scenarios + fresh offline run).

decision_on_asserted_evidence.description: Golden-observed vocabulary (demo-run scenarios + fresh offline run).

execution_class.description: LIVE-RUN EXTENSION. offline-gate = the deterministic loop alone decided; live-local = a model ran outside production; live-production = the deployed endpoint.

fail_closed.description: LIVE-RUN EXTENSION. True when a live execution failed and the deterministic gate loop produced this receipt instead — the fail-closed floor (SPEC section 5).

model.description: LIVE-RUN EXTENSION. The model that actually ran, stamped per execution.

tool_trace.description: LIVE-RUN EXTENSION. One entry per tool invocation, in execution order.

title: StudySprint run receipt (base + live-run extension)
